description: Every arithmetic isomorphism from the standard natural numbers to an arithmetic structure \(M\) sends each natural number \(n\) to the numeral value \(n_M\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.SecondOrderArithmetic.canonical_isomorphism_unique.{u} (M : Type u)
  [Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.language.Structure M]
  (e : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.language.Equiv ℕ M) (n : ℕ) :
  e n = Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.numeralValue M n
